role: Mid/Senior Analytics Engineer for BA's Client (B2B contract)
responsibilities: Help shape the client's Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) process, aligning sales, demand, supply, and inventory planning across a manufacturing business.
Collaborate with business stakeholders to assess current planning practices, identify gaps, and define planning requirements, KPIs, and reporting priorities.
Translate S&OP requirements into analytical data models and Power BI dashboards supporting demand and supply balancing, inventory visibility, and plan-versus-actual analysis.
Identify and integrate data from Dynamics 365 and other business systems into Microsoft Fabric, ensuring reliable and consistent planning inputs.
Collaborate with the ERP implementation team to align analytics solutions with business processes and data structures introduced through the Dynamics 365 migration.
Validate data and analytical outputs with business users, investigate discrepancies, and support solution adoption during regular S&OP reviews.
Design and develop analytics solutions using Microsoft Fabric and Power BI.
Develop and optimize data processing solutions using Spark and SQL.
Contribute to Lakehouse and Data Warehouse (DWH) architecture implementation, including Medallion Architecture (Bronze → Silver → Gold).

evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: ensuring reliable and consistent planning inputs
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: The responsibilities stress reliability, validation and discrepancy investigation ('reliable and consistent planning inputs', 'Validate data and analytical outputs') with no velocity language; 'ASAP' is a start date, not a working style.
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: The client is a manufacturer and the outputs are planning and inventory reports, with no financial-reporting or regulatory language, so moderate.
evidence.data_team_maturity: building a modern analytics platform using Microsoft Fabric and Power BI
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: The client is migrating its ERP and building its analytics platform from the ground up ('building a modern analytics platform'), so the data function is early.
evidence.jd_authorship: Translate S&OP requirements into analytical data models and Power BI dashboards supporting demand and supply balancing, inventory visibility, and plan-versus-actual analysis.
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Bullets name the business process, systems and architecture precisely (S&OP, Dynamics 365, Fabric, Medallion Architecture), so a reader knows what the work involves.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: aligning sales, demand, supply, and inventory planning across a manufacturing business
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The audience is the client's sales and operations planners, which splits between commercial (sales, demand) and operational (supply, inventory) users with neither dominating.
evidence.autonomy_level: Help shape the client's Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) process
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: The role helps shape and define the planning process ('define planning requirements, KPIs, and reporting priorities') while also building and supporting adoption of the solutions.
evidence.ai_role_explanation: No AI tools or AI-facing data work is mentioned.
evidence.testing_framing: Validate data and analytical outputs with business users, investigate discrepancies
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: The candidate owns validating outputs and investigating discrepancies, which is an accountable quality practice rather than a listed tool.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing: ensuring reliable and consistent planning inputs
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: Reliability of planning inputs is a concern but sits behind delivery of the new platform and dashboards.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: building a modern analytics platform using Microsoft Fabric and Power BI
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: The project migrates to a new ERP and builds a new Fabric lakehouse and dashboards, so building new dominates.
evidence.language_gate: English language proficiency at B2+ level.
